ordering: softmax BEFORE any pooling or cropping
why_this_matters: One MIRAGE pass instead of 75. ~66 min once versus ~45 h of live forward across the schedule, and MIRAGE's 95.6M params never need to be resident during JEPA training, fine-tuning or downstream evaluation.
not_yet_done: The training dataset still reads the OLD 1-bit envelope cache at mirage_guides. Wiring GuidedOCTSliceDataset to read schema-2 soft_scores is the next step; until then the anatomy mode runs on the binary envelope's per-patch occupancy, which works but merges inner retina and choroid into one class.
